Bill.BriefDescription: Marketing, offering, or selling camping resort contracts.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to camping resort contracts; and amending RCW19.105.310 and 19.105.325.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.105.310 and 1988 c 159 s 2 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Except in transactions exempt under RCW 19.105.325, it is unlawfulfor any person to market, offer, or sell a camping resort contract inthis state or to a Washington state resident unless the camping resortcontract is registered and the operator or registrant has received apermit to market the registered contracts under this chapter.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 19.105.325 and 1988 c 159 s 4 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The following transactions are exempt from registration underthis chapter: (a) An offer or sale by a government or governmental agency; (b) A bona fide pledge of a camping resort contract; and (c) Offerings and dispositions of resale camping resort contractsby purchasers thereof on their own behalf or by third parties brokering p. 1 SSB 5002on behalf of purchasers, other than resale contracts forfeited by orplaced into an operator's sale inventory. However, the sale of morethan one resale camp resort contract by any person or business, not onbehalf of purchasers, requires registration under this chapter. (2) The director may, by rule or order, exempt any person, whollyor partially, from any or all requirements of this chapter if thedirector finds the requirements are not necessary for the protection ofthe public health, safety, and welfare.
